description: Platform recovery rules. Offline assessment is not verified eligibility or approval. No restore executor is registered.

checks.beforeCaptured: Retain the observed before-state separately from the previous desired release.
checks.qualifiedBaseline: Select a product-verified release or verified before/apply tag receipts; Preview or pipeline success alone does not qualify.
checks.artifactsRetained: Retain the exact release template, parameters and package, or the before/apply tag receipts, for the recovery window.
checks.integrityVerified: Verify candidate hashes and original registered pipeline, repository, run and source provenance.
checks.sameTarget: Bind the candidate to the same tenant, subscription, target and stack where applicable.
checks.coverageComplete: Collect fresh required state; denied, partial or unknown reads block recovery.
checks.ownershipVerified: Restrict changes to owned resources and approved tag keys; preserve shared and unrelated state.
checks.currentPolicyPassed: Apply current security policy and supported adapter/schema versions to the older candidate.
checks.compatibleChanges: Qualify each resource/property change against its provider and product recovery contract.
checks.credentialsCurrent: Preserve approved identity and secret references; never implicitly restore old credentials.
checks.freshPreview: Produce a new current-to-candidate Preview bound to the recovery request and within its freshness limit.
checks.noDrift: Re-read and compare state under the protected target lock immediately before applying.
checks.protectedApproval: Use a separately approved recovery request and the registered protected target bindings.
checks.verificationDefined: Define after-state reconciliation and product verification, including partial and unknown outcomes.
checks.packageCompatible: Retain the exact prior application package and verify current security and state/schema compatibility.
checks.processingImpactReviewed: Review trigger/worker activation and downstream processing effects before restoring code.
checks.tagKeysOwned: Compensate only tag keys recorded as changed by this operation.
checks.tagCurrentMatchesApplied: Require each affected current tag value to match the value recorded after Apply; conflicts block compensation.

policies.name: Blob copy
policies.summary: Restore compatible infrastructure and the retained application package after a fresh recovery Preview.
exclusions: Copied blobs and transfer-ledger history
Replaying transfers or restoring credentials
Deleting new storage or replacing identities

policies.name: Event flow
policies.summary: Restore compatible workflow configuration and package after reviewing trigger and connector effects.
exclusions: Events already delivered and downstream actions
Automatic event replay
Deleting new stateful resources or restoring credentials

policies.name: Private Storage Workspace
policies.summary: Restore qualified mutable account configuration while preserving stored data and new resources.
exclusions: Blob/file contents or deleted storage accounts
Data-plane ACL recovery
Irreversible settings and automatic resource deletion

policies.name: Key Vault
policies.summary: Restore qualified mutable vault configuration after identity and current policy checks.
exclusions: Secret/key contents and old credential versions
Reversing purge protection
Deleted vault or identity recovery

policies.name: Observability
policies.summary: Restore qualified workbook and alert configuration while preserving the shared workspace.
exclusions: Deleted or expired telemetry
Changing the shared workspace or undoing retention side effects
Recreating workspaces or recovering application data

policies.name: HTTP Functions API
policies.summary: Restore compatible infrastructure and the exact retained application package; verify health and authentication.
exclusions: External API side effects
Incompatible data/schema changes
Deleted resources and old credentials

policies.name: Service Bus worker
policies.summary: Restore compatible hosting, package and messaging configuration after reviewing processing effects.
exclusions: Consumed messages, acknowledgements and external effects
Queue recreation or automatic message replay
Incompatible state/schema changes

policies.name: External-resource tags
policies.summary: Plan per-key compensation using before, applied and current values; preserve unrelated tags.
exclusions: Conflicting subsequent edits
Replacing the entire tag dictionary
Removal of newly introduced keys until a removal adapter is qualified

policies.name: Source-owned tags
policies.summary: Revert reviewed source settings and use the workload's normal Preview/Deploy route.
exclusions: Direct tag patches that bypass source ownership

policies.name: Private network and IPAM
policies.summary: Reconcile resource ownership, dependencies and durable allocations with the platform owner.
exclusions: Automatic subnet deletion or IPAM release
Treating an apparently unused range as safe to release
Assuming stack detach removes dependencies

policies.name: ADO definition registration
policies.summary: Reconcile Created, Reused and Uncertain receipts before any separate administrative change.
exclusions: Deleting reused definitions
Automatically deleting definitions now used by runs or other users

policies.name: Discovery and diagrams
policies.summary: Read-only evidence can be refreshed; there is no workload mutation to restore.
exclusions: Deleting source resources as an inverse of discovery

policies.name: Agent reviews
policies.summary: Retain the review and receipt, or run another review; advice does not modify Azure.
exclusions: Executing an agent-generated inverse operation

policies.name: Bicep source drafts
policies.summary: Review, retain or discard the local draft through its normal source workflow.
exclusions: Cloud recovery for an unqualified, undeployed draft
